question: The selling price of 22 books is equal to the cost price of 11 books. Find the loss or gain percentage.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given, 22 × SP = 11 × CP

Ratio of SP to CP = 11 ÷ 22 = 1 ÷ 2

Loss = CP − SP = 2 − 1 = 1 unit

Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100 = (1 ÷ 2) × 100 = 50%

**∴ The correct answer is 50% loss.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) of 22 books = Cost Price (CP) of 11 books.

**Formula Used:**

Loss = CP − SP

Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100
